texlab.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between client and language server.

texlab.build.executable.description: Path to a LaTeX build tool.

texlab.build.args.description: Additional arguments that are passed to the build tool.

texlab.build.useFileList.description: Use the .fls files produced by the TeX engine as an additional input for project detection. May impact performance.

texlab.build.auxDirectory.description: Directory containing the .aux files, when not using latexmk.

texlab.build.logDirectory.description: Directory containing the build log files, when not using latexmk.

texlab.build.pdfDirectory.description: Directory containing the output files, when not using latexmk.

texlab.build.filename.description: Overrides the default file name of the build artifact, used to find the PDF file for forward search.

texlab.auxDirectory.description: DEPRECATED: Directory containing the build artifacts. Use texlab.build.auxDirectory instead.

texlab.forwardSearch.executable.description: Path to a PDF previewer that supports SyncTeX.

texlab.forwardSearch.args.description: Additional arguments that are passed to the previewer.

texlab.chktex.onOpenAndSave.description: Lint using chktex after opening and saving a file.

texlab.chktex.onEdit.description: Lint using chktex after changing a file

texlab.chktex.additionalArgs.description: Additional command line arguments that are passed to chktex. Don't redefine the -I and -f flags.

texlab.diagnosticsDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before reporting diagnostics.

texlab.diagnostics.allowedPatterns.description: Only diagnostics matching at least one of these regular expressions are reported.

texlab.diagnostics.ignoredPatterns.description: Diagnostics matching any of these regular expressions are not reported.

texlab.symbols.allowedPatterns.description: Only document symbols matching at least one of these regular expressions are sent to the client.

texlab.symbols.ignoredPatterns.description: Document symbols matching any of these regular expressions are not sent to the client.

displayName.description: The name shown in the document symbols. By default, title case is used.

label.description: If set, the server will try to match a label to the environment and append its number.

texlab.symbols.customEnvironments.description: Extends the list of environments that are part of the document symbols.

texlab.formatterLineLength.description: Maximum amount of characters per line (0 = disable).

texlab.latexindent.replacement.description: Additional replacement flag that is added when calling latexindent.

texlab.completion.matcher.description: The algorithm used to filter the completion items returned to the client.

texlab.hover.symbols.description: The way symbol-like commands (e. g. \epsilon) are displayed during a hover request.

texlab.inlayHints.maxLength.description: When set, truncate the text of the inlay hints to the specified length.

texlab.experimental.followPackageLinks.description: Resolve dependencies of custom packages and include them in the dependency graph.

texlab.experimental.mathEnvironments.description: Extends the list of environments considered as math environments (e. g. "align*").

texlab.experimental.enumEnvironments.description: Extends the list of environments considered as enumeration environments (e. g. "enumerate").

texlab.experimental.verbatimEnvironments.description: Extends the list of environments considered as verbatim environments (e. g. "minted").

texlab.experimental.citationCommands.description: Extends the list of citation commands. Commands must be written without a leading backslash.

texlab.experimental.labelDefinitionComma.description: Extends the list of \label-like commands. Commands must be written without a leading backslash.

texlab.experimental.labelReferenceComman.description: Extends the list of \ref-like commands. Commands must be written without a leading backslash.

texlab.experimental.labelReferenceRangeC.description: Extends the list of \crefrange-like commands. Commands must be written without a leading backslash.

texlab.experimental.glossaryReferenceCom.description: Extends the list of \gls-like commands. Commands must be written without a leading backslash.

texlab.experimental.labelDefinitionPrefi.description: Associates a label definition command with a custom prefix, e. g. [["thm", "thm:"]].

texlab.experimental.labelReferencePrefix.description: Associates a label reference command with a custom prefix, e. g. [["thmref", "thm:"]].
